list_COMMENTS: list comments on a Feishu document using the file token and optional pagination
list_REPLIES: list all replies in a comment thread on a Feishu document by file token and comment ID
reply_TO_COMMENT: reply to a local comment thread on a Feishu document with plain text content
add_COMMENT: add a new whole-document comment on a Feishu document using file token and content
check_FEISHU: check whether the lark_oapi library is available for Feishu API operations
